answer: Give every agent a small plot in a shared garden that only grows while its owner keeps showing up: stake a deposit that unlocks slowly, season after season, and let reputation deepen with each honest, attested trade. A sybil farmer can spin up a thousand fresh wallets, but every new plot starts as bare tundra, with no history, no roots and no borrowing power. Real agents accumulate rings like trees; fakes stay frozen seedlings, bright and brief as a comet, gone long before the orchard would ever trust them with real weight.
